title: Kernel component of the completion projection formula
statement: theorem flat_and_quotients_projection_kernel (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : C), RingHom.ker ((projection J A I n).hom.app (op U)).hom = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun a : ↥(I ^ (n + 1)) ↦ (algebraSection (coefficientMap J A I) a).val (op U)))

proof.text: Equip the sections of each finite constant quotient with the module structure induced by the constant-presheaf sheafification unit of that quotient ring. Apply finiteSystem_properties to these concrete structures to obtain the scalar towers, sectionwise flatness, surjective transitions and normalized tensor reduction equivalences.

Apply sectionwise_adic_algebra_limit to finiteSystemUnder. Its final clause provides ring equivalences from the quotient of the under-category limit by the extended coefficient ideal power to the finite stages, normalized by the original projections. Injectivity of each equivalence and the quotient zero criterion identify each projection kernel with that extended ideal.

Lift the actual coefficientMap and projection cone to the under-category. Its underlying cone is the specified finiteSystem limit, so reflection of limits by Under.forget makes it limiting. The unique isomorphism to the chosen under-category limit commutes with every projection. Evaluation gives an A-algebra equivalence on sections, preserving algebraMap. Transport ideal membership through this equivalence using Ideal.map_map and Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective. Finally the image of the coefficient ideal power is its span of coefficientMap images of constantSection, which are definitionally the displayed algebraSection values.
